title: Nested if/else Statements
description: Place an inner if(age >= 35)/else check inside an outer if(age >= 18) block to test two age thresholds in sequence.
source: draft: agy free model + edit: codex

steps.description: Set int age = 38 and check the outer condition if(age >= 18) on line 5, printing 'You are old enough to vote!' on line 6.

Inside the outer if block, check the nested condition if(age >= 35) on line 8. This prints whether the person can also run for President. If the outer check is false, run the outer else on lines 13-15.

steps.question: Which println statements run when age is 38? What would print for an age that passes the outer threshold but falls below the inner threshold?
steps.answer: When age is 38, both age >= 18 and age >= 35 are true, so lines 6 and 9 both print. For an age that passes the outer threshold but falls below the inner threshold, lines 6 and 11 would print.

steps.description: Watch execution print line 6 and then enter the nested if(age >= 35) block on line 9.
